newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH 2006 BOND YIELD TO TEST 6.00 PCT - UNIBANK.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH 2006 BOND YIELD TO TEST 6.00 PCT - UNIBANK.

text.p: The Finnish 2006 bond yield is likely to fall further and test 6.00 percent, Danish Unibank said in its weekly Nordic Update report received on Monday.
"A test of 6.00 percent is on the cards," Unibank said.
Last week, the 2006 bond yield fell through 6.09 percent, which Unibank said had been a "minor technical level".

The Danish bank said the Finnish 2006 benchmark's yield spread over Bunds had risen to around 37 basis points from 35 bps, and advised investors to buy Finland against Germany as long as the premium remained below 40 bps.
